caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a brown frame and four slightly curved legs. The backrest features a horizontal top rail and a decorative carved panel with a central diamond-shaped motif flanked by scrollwork, all rendered in a matching brown hue. The seat cushion has a floral upholstery pattern, dominated by shades of green, yellow, blue, pink, and some muted tones. The chair is positioned at a slight angle, showing both the side and a partial front view. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or elements present. There is a small, cursive signature in the bottom left corner.
title: Side Chair
